core_obligations: Factor Delta_{X/S} through X x_Y X -> X x_S X and deduce that Delta_{X/Y} is representable using that X x_Y X -> X x_S X is a monomorphism (proof lines 397-414).
Choose a surjective etale U -> X and build the cartesian diagram relating R = U x_X U, U x_Y U and U x_S U to X, X x_Y X and X x_S X (proof lines 417-428).

Transfer properties (2)-(5) from R -> U x_S U to R -> U x_Y U using that R -> U x_S U is a monomorphism and that local finite typeness and monomorphismhood survive the factorization (proof lines 429-437).
Verify each of (2), (3), (4) and (5) explicitly for R -> U x_Y U and conclude for Delta_{X/Y} (proof lines 440-450).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma listing five properties of the diagonal Delta_{X/Y} of a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S: it is representable, locally of finite type, a monomorphism, separated and locally quasi-finite (source lines 381-394). The proof first factors Delta_{X/S} through X x_Y X -> X x_S X and uses that the latter is a monomorphism to deduce representability formally, then transfers properties (2)-(5) to the scheme level through the cartesian diagram with R = U x_X U over an etale cover U -> X, using that the properties are etale local on the source-and-target, and finally derives each property from the corresponding elementary fact about monomorphisms and locally finite type morphisms of schemes.
